decision.reason: [ev-5ce528be35f7] is one changelog line saying OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics support was added. It points to PR #8999 for the details. It does not name any configuration key, provider option, CLI flag or middleware field, so the subject can't be identified. It also doesn't say whether the support is opt-in or replaces an existing tracing or metrics backend, so there's no basis for the applicability condition. To settle subject and applicability we need the PR description, the v3 tracing/metrics documentation, or the migration-guide section that defines the new configuration surface.
